models.note: encode throughput measured with 2-3 encoders sharing the RX580 (lower bound); query latency on an idle card, 40 sequential queries

protocol.coverage_rule: query has a grade>=2 page in the canary canon
protocol.fusion: RRF k=60 over top-100 lists; E = top-100 re-scored by late MaxSim
protocol.significance: paired sign-flip randomization 10000 (seed 20260928) + percentile bootstrap 95% CI; worth_it = delta>=0.02 and CI lo>0
protocol.text_rerank: top-24 unique canonical candidates -> VKM API /v1/rerank/text -> EDGE jina-reranker-v3.5; 413 -> top-12 -> top-7; still failing -> first-stage order (fail-open)
protocol.visual_rerank: top-8 images (FIGURE crop or page image) -> VKM API /v1/rerank/visual -> EDGE jina-reranker-m0

rerank_token_budget_finding.consequence: 24 saturated candidates (160 tokens each) need 4337-4465 tokens > 4096 -> HTTP 413; n<=7 always fits
